phrases.text: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?
The children found a treasure map leading to underground tunnels beneath the park.
They repaired faulty electrical systems to revive dormant amusement rides.
They allied with a one-eyed doctor and naval officer after entering a hidden chamber.
The glowing man transported them through a portal to a parallel dimension.
A storm forced them to decode old park blueprints in a shelter.
They convinced park staff to unlock restricted maintenance areas.
children examining a folded map on the ground
children following a path marked by glowing symbols underground
people working on exposed wires with tools and flashlights
amusement rides flickering back to life with lights and sounds
people entering a dimly lit room with a single eye-shaped symbol
a man with one eye and a naval uniform standing beside a group
a glowing figure standing beside a shimmering circular portal
people stepping through a glowing portal into a different environment
